journeys.name: Classification: category, sub category with its asset account, deactivate
journeys.objective: Assets are grouped, and each sub category knows the account of Finance its assets are carried on.
journeys.userRole: Asset administrator, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the fixed asset right. A leaf asset account in Finance (19-finance.xlsx).
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Fixed assets and clicks Classification in the menu
2. Clicks "Category"
3. Types the code and the name of the category in "Category / holder" and clicks "Save"
4. Types the code of the sub category, the category in "Category / holder" and the account in "Account / item", chooses "Sub category" and clicks "Save"
5. Types the code of the sub category, chooses "Deactivate" and clicks "Save"
6. Looks for the categories in the table
journeys.expectedOutcome: A sub category belongs to one category and has one asset account.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/fixed-assets/masters opened (HTTP 200, title "Classification"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Category" on /fixed-assets/masters opened the dialog "Classification"; fields: "Code", "Category / holder", "Account / item", "Action"; buttons: Close, Save. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: No account; a category that does not exist; deactivating a sub category with assets (test case below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 6 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.
journeys.requiredTestData: Category "X-ALKES" "X Alat kesehatan uji"; sub category "X-USG" in that category with the asset account 1501

journeys.name: Register: buying, installing and commissioning an asset
journeys.objective: A bought item becomes an asset with a number, a sub category and serial numbers, and counts as in use from its commissioning.
journeys.userRole: Asset administrator, Purchasing officer, Inventory administrator (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the fixed asset right. One branch is chosen in the header. An approved purchase order of Procurement and its internal id (09-procurement.xlsx). The item received into a store of Inventory with a batch (07-inventory.xlsx). A sub category.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Fixed assets and clicks Register in the menu
2. Clicks "Buy"
3. Types the number and the item in "Account / item", pastes the id of the purchase order into "Document", clicks "Next", types the quantity and clicks "Save"
4. Clicks "Use" on the row, opens the dialog, types the sub category in "Category / holder" and the serial number in "Serial / location / reason", clicks "Next", types the store and the batch, chooses "Install" and clicks "Save"
5. Chooses "Commission" for the same asset and clicks "Save"
6. Types the asset number in "Find asset number" and clicks the button
journeys.expectedOutcome: An asset is bought, then installed, then commissioned. One serial number per installed piece.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/fixed-assets/register opened (HTTP 200, title "Register"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Buy" on /fixed-assets/register opened the dialog "Register"; fields: "Number", "Code", "Category / holder", "Account / item", "Document", "Serial / location / reason"; buttons: Close, Back, Next. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: A purchase order that is not approved; serial numbers missing; not enough stock; commissioning before installation (test case below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 1 of 6 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.
journeys.requiredTestData: Number "X-FA-001"; item "X-USG-01"; quantity 1; sub category "X-USG"; serial "X-SN-0001"; store "X Gudang umum" and its batch

journeys.name: Depreciation, sale and write-off, booked in Finance
journeys.objective: The value an asset loses, and its end by sale or write-off, are on record and reach Finance.
journeys.userRole: Asset accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the fixed asset right. One branch is chosen in the header. A commissioned asset. A go-ahead to create Finance vouchers on the test site.
journeys.steps:
1. On Register, clicks "Use" on the asset and then "Buy" to open the dialog
2. Clicks "Next", types the end date of last month in "Date" and 2500000 in "Amount", chooses "Depreciate" and clicks "Save"
3. Looks for the cost, the accumulated depreciation and the book value of the asset
4. Types 40000000 in "Amount", chooses "Sell" and clicks "Save"
5. For the second asset, types the reason in "Serial / location / reason", chooses "Write off" and clicks "Save"
journeys.expectedOutcome: Depreciation needs a commissioned asset and a date that is not in the future.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/fixed-assets/register opened (HTTP 200, title "Register"). The steps were not executed: they change data.

journeys.requiredTestData: Asset "X-FA-001"; depreciation to the end of last month, amount 2500000; sale for 40000000; for a second asset the write-off reason "X rusak total"

journeys.name: One asset from the purchase order to its disposal, across the applications
journeys.objective: The life of one asset can be followed from the order that bought it to the day it left the books.
journeys.userRole: Purchasing officer, Asset administrator, Maintenance officer, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the fixed asset right. One branch is chosen in the header. The journeys above; a breakdown and a work order in Maintenance for the same asset code (26-maintenance.xlsx).
journeys.steps:
1. Purchasing officer approves a purchase order and receives the item (09-procurement.xlsx)
2. Asset administrator buys, installs and commissions the asset
3. Issues the asset to a holder and moves it to a location
4. Maintenance officer reports a breakdown for the asset number and completes a work order
5. Asset accountant depreciates the asset for three months and then sells it
6. Looks, from the asset, for its purchase order, its movements, its repairs and its vouchers
journeys.expectedOutcome: TBD with the product owner: where the history and the book value of an asset are read.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/fixed-assets/register opened (HTTP 200, title "Register"). The steps were not executed: they change data.
journeys.failureScenarios: An asset whose cost, place and end cannot be traced.
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English.

journeys.name: Access to Fixed assets: session, licence and write privilege
journeys.objective: The application is reachable only with a session, only on a tenant that holds its licence, and writes need the write privilege.
journeys.userRole: Not signed in; admin of a tenant without the licence; a role without the write privilege
journeys.preconditions: A browser without a session; for the licence and privilege cases, accounts that are not available yet.
journeys.steps:
1. Without a session, opens /id/fixed-assets
2. On a tenant without the licence, opens /id/fixed-assets
3. With a role without the write privilege, tries to save on a screen of the application
journeys.expectedOutcome: 1. Redirect to /id/login?next=/fixed-assets. 2. Redirect to /id/apps (frontend/src/proxy.ts, features/licensing/assert-entitled.ts; licence KLIKMED-IP); the API answers 403 "not entitled for this module". 3. The API answers 403 "missing required privilege".
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-12: without a session /id/fixed-assets ended at /id/login?next=%2Ffixed-assets (HTTP 200). Steps 2 and 3 not executed: no second tenant and no restricted account were authorised.
journeys.alternativePaths: Deep link to a sub-screen instead of the landing screen.
journeys.failureScenarios: Session expired while a form is open (TBD: behaviour not confirmed).
journeys.dependencies: Accounts per role; a tenant without the licence (README lists the other showcase hosts)
journeys.validationNotes: Generated in this run. Read routes of the application are guarded by the licence only, not by a role (see RISK-01 in qa/open-questions.md).
